participation.context: Promised only the arranged road, and a look with no purchase in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set both halves of the bargain, and withheld the name and the price.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

relations.quote: Don't promise me a house, Will.

story.body: You kept the eighteenth as the only journey you would promise, because it is already set. You agreed to look when Anne takes you, and you did not ask which house or what it would cost. She did not tell you.

relations.quote: Don't promise me a house, Will.

title: Agreed to look at a house, and promised only the eighteenth

participation.context: Asked how to mend it, said carried, and did not follow him down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took the six pairs and refused the speech.
participation.name: Richard Shakespeare

relations.note: he carries what the back cannot

story.body: You gave Richard the errand you had meant to walk, in the words he asked for, and you stayed on the floor.
